div.head: I Cn 7
div.ab: And we lærað ⁊ biddað ⁊ on Godes naman beodað, þæt ænig Cristen mann binnon VI manna sibfæce on his agenum cynne æfre ne gewifie, ne on mæges lafe, þe swa neahsib wære, ne on þæs wifes nedmagon, þe he sylf ær hæfde;

And we læreð ⁊ biddað ⁊ on Godes naman beodað, þæt ænig Cristen mann binnan six manna sibba fæce on his agenan cynne æfre ne gewifige, ne on his mæges lafe, þe swa neahsib wære, ne on his wifes nedmagan, þe he sylf ær hæfde;

⁊ we lærað ⁊ we biddað ⁊ on Godes naman beodað, þæt ænig Cristen man binnon six manna sibfæce on his agenum cynne æfre ne wifige, ne on his mæges leafe, þe swa neahsib wære, ne on ðæs wifes nydmagan, þe he silf ær hæfde,

Unde commonemus, petimus et in nomine Dei precipimus, ut nemo in parentela sua intra sextam generationem uxoretur, nec in dimissa cognati sui, qui intra sextum geniculum pertineat ei, nec in cognatione uxoris suę;

And we lærað ⁊ biddað ⁊ on Godes naman beodað, þæt ænig Cristen mann binnon VI manna sibfæce on his agenum cynne æfre ne gewifie, ne on his mæges lafe þe swa neahsib wære, ne on þæs wifes nedmagon þe he sylf ær hæfde;

And we lærað and biddað and on Godes naman beodað þæt ænig Cristen mann binnon VI manna sibfæce on his agenum cynne æfre ne gewifie, ne on his mæges lafe, þe swa neahsib wære, ne on þæs wifes nedmagon þe he sylf ær hæfde.

Und wir ermahnen und (wir D) bitten und gebieten in Gottes Namen, dass kein christlicher Mann jemals sich beweibe mit seiner [eigenen] Geschlechts[genossin] innerhalb des Verwandtschaftsabstandes von [nur] sechs Menschen oder mit der Wittwe seines Blutsverwandten, der so nahverwandt gewesen ist, noch mit einer Blutsverwandten des (seines A) Weibes, das er selbst früher gehabt hat;

And we instruct and (we, D) ask and command in God's name that no Christian man ever marry [a woman] of his own kin within the degree of [only] six persons, or the widow of his kinsman who was so closely related, or a blood-relative of the (his, A) wife whom he himself had before;

And we instruct and pray and enjoin, in the name of God, that no Christian man shall ever marry among his own kin within six degrees of relationship, or with the widow of a man as nearly related to him as that, or with a near relative of his first wife's.

And we instruct, pray, and decree in God’s name that no Christian man shall ever take a wife within six degrees of kinship in his own family, nor the widow of one so closely related, nor a close relative of his first wife.
